title: Earthrise: The 45th Anniversary (real-time version)
contents: NASA Goddard visualization (from LRO data) recreating the Apollo 8 Earthrise moment in real time, synced with the actual onboard crew audio ('Oh my God, look at that picture over there!'), with on-screen subtitles and a telemetry box. Earth rises over the lunar horizon; ends on the iconic Earthrise framing.
